source_evidence: Day328~14:40 exact player 'use superiority dice and knack and past if needed' authorizes ordered conditional enhancements to SAME pending Persuasion10 (advantage3/3+7), DC13 candid testimony and DC18 willingness to help secure records. Commanding Presence applies to Persuasion per campaign/continuity/rules-combat-recovery.md; actual visible Python secrets receipt e720a8e8dff59b9f6c8fdabdb09b0bfa d8 face8 yields10+8=18, both thresholds met. Spend one Superiority Die4/4→3/4; no Knack or Past Life roll/spend, Psi4/6 PastLife1/3 unchanged. No new d20. Sornell independently elects to cooperate with Desen's voluntary inquiry, not under immunity or financial guarantee. He candidly confirms he personally entered D3206gp and D3238gp paid inspection notices in joint freight fee book, the broker reimbursed the payments from the account and Harthvale authorized the arrangement; Tavosk's signed14gp acknowledgement accompanied those entries. He confirms keeping Lot27 36gp sale records and that Halvessa's prospective250gp exclusivity investment is still a proposal, not paid; no claim he personally witnessed every cargo transfer or payment, no new prohibited goods or murder link established. Sornell says 'I will identify the books and explain the entries to your examiner. I won't go back there alone.' He agrees to give a truthful recorded statement to Desen; Desen makes contemporaneous notes, no completed signed deposition, original record surrender, retrieval, seizure, warrant or arrest yet. Sornell fears being blamed and seeks safety if he cooperates; no specific observed threat, order, resignation or guaranteed settlement asserted. Desen agrees to arrange a private safe place while coordinating lawful preservation with customs, not promise immunity or payment; the actual arrangements and securing of records remain pending. Desen takes responsibility for these ordinary professional steps, no compulsory further V undercover mission. Mara/Fenar/Cirren hear testimony; V chooses next action. No new money, document custody transfer, spell, HP, other resource or actual partnership change.
